fact: The ministry's Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024 states, against a 2019 baseline, that information systems are largely manual, that there is no central computerised data repository for health and that the health information system in Rodrigues is largely manual, and sets strategic goal 18 to strengthen the health information system, including an Integrated Health Management Information System under the E-Health project.
title: Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024: Caring for People's Health and Well-Being across the Lifespan
publisher: Ministry of Health and Wellness, Republic of Mauritius
